source_semantics.review: Individually review all13 complete files and38 hunks of the dialog standalone example migration. Seven examples and four internal app/demo files replace module imports with the exact public title/content/actions/close directives used by each component, or remove an unused dialog module import; the kitchen-sink example also removes that module. The example spec removes MatDialogModule setup and the modern dialog harness fixture becomes standalone with individual directives instead of a declaration. The full finite metadata projection retains every operation outside the individually recorded import/approved metadata roles, including other imports, providers, templates, constructors, open/config/data behavior, callbacks and cleanup. All13 source test identities and complete callback semantics remain. This is executable fixture/compiler/provider configuration, not editorial text or a proof that providers and standalone scopes are interchangeable. The owned legacy title/content/actions/close directives remain standalone:false, their module declares/exports them and provides the legacy dialog/scroll strategy. The shared historical harness still declares its fixture, imports the supplied module, preserves the service alias provider and uses owned LEGACY_NOOP_ANIMATIONS. Preserve that Material16 module/markup/token contract; do not adopt this modern standalone recipe or a compiler/provider shortcut. Whole owned product/callback guards and actual Cyph module/style context stay unchanged; no consumer TS/API, HTML, CSS or SCSS edit is needed. Real compiler/DI/render/floor validation remains separate.
